names: three coherent role profiles retain exact mode, source rows and entry binding
three roles use one inventory of 555 declared reads, not three physical passes
all role views retain literal scoped-package at signs and the same bare binding
unsupported mode refuses before a declared read
unknown role refuses before a declared read
two roles cannot acquire the same entry
traversal in a role entry refuses before a declared read
an unrelated profile kind refuses before a declared read
a missing child entry cannot produce an incomplete role bundle
physical aliases refuse before publishing role metadata
changed declared source bytes refuse every role
a source-row digest mismatch refuses before a declared read
decoded role DATA views are independent without a source copy

limits: The 555 source rows are declared in-memory fixture DATA, not installed dependencies.
These controls do not execute the P2 application, child processes, interruption or recovery.
One source inventory per bundle was already present in V4; no threefold speedup is claimed.
P2 V5 native execution, physical resource release and production readiness remain NOT_EXECUTED or unqualified.
